t: This is Liberty, the vast mock-Tudor department store on Great Marlborough Street. It runs from Carnaby Street in the east to Kingly Street in the west, and forms a three-storey archway over the northern entrance to the Kingly Street mall. The Liberty Clock hangs at its centre. The store is famous for bold floral print fabrics and for its link to art and culture. It was founded by Sir Arthur Lasenby Liberty, a British merchant, who also owned it.
